description: Ministry of Justice - The Food (Iodization of Salt) Regulation - 2023
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980, specifically the Food (Iodization of Salt) Regulations 2023. It establishes legal requirements for salt iodization, registration procedures, quality standards, and compliance measures. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
